basic_details.job_title: Gurugram University Adjunct Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Must have educational qualification prescribed by UGC/respective Statutory Body, or be an eminent person / accomplished professional from industry.
qualification.details: Qualification: Educational qualification as prescribed by UGC / respective Statutory Body; Recognized by various bodies in his field Experience: Domain knowledge of significant value for industry candidates Age limit: Maximum 65 years Age relaxation: description Engagement beyond 65 years is discouraged except in the case of persons with exceptionally brilliant academic/industrial background. | Other conditions: | No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Walk in interview Number of positions can be increased or decreased

salary_details.pay_scale: Professor/equivalent: Rs. 4000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 80,000 per month), Associate Professor/equivalent: Rs. 3000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 60,000 per month), Assistant Professor/equivalent: Rs. 2000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 40,000 per month).

how_to_apply: Report for walk-in interview with filled application form, original documents / degree and one set of self-attested copies.
Report at least half an hour before the scheduled walk-in interview.
Attend on 12 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.
important_instructions: Candidates are required to report at least half an hour before the scheduled Walk-in-interview.

rows.gurugram_university_gurugram_gug_haryana: Professor/equivalent: Rs. 4000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 80,000 per month), Associate Professor/equivalent: Rs. 3000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 60,000 per month), Assistant Professor/equivalent: Rs. 2000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 40,000 per month).
Must have educational qualification prescribed by UGC/respective Statutory Body, or be an eminent person / accomplished professional from industry.

content_sections.heading: GUG Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AFT-03/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GUG notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Educational qualification as prescribed by UGC / respective Statutory Body; Recognized by various bodies in his field Experience: Domain knowledge of significant value for industry candidates Age limit: Maximum 65 years Age relaxation: description Engagement beyond 65 years is discouraged except in the case of persons with exceptionally brilliant academic/industrial background. Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Walk in interview Number of positions can be increased or decreased

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GUG Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Late arrivals will not be permitted to appear for the interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration of appointment shall vary from one semester (6 months) to six semesters (3 years)

content_sections.heading: How Will GUG Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Department level discussion Recommendation by Committee Approval by competent authority Walk-in interview on scheduled date and time

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application forms Original documents / degree One set of self-attested copies of documents / degree

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GUG Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill application form. Report for walk-in interview with filled application form, original documents / degree and one set of self-attested copies. Report at least half an hour before the scheduled walk-in interview. Attend on 12 November 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to report at least half an hour before the scheduled Walk-in-interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for GUG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GUG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Adjunct Faculty.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GUG Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 12 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Gurugram University, Sector-87, Gurugram.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years. Relaxation: description Engagement beyond 65 years is discouraged except in the case of persons with exceptionally brilliant academic/industrial background..

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Professor/equivalent: Rs. 4000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 80,000 per month), Associate Professor/equivalent: Rs. 3000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 60,000 per month), Assistant Professor/equivalent: Rs. 2000 per day (Ceiling Rs. 40,000 per month).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have educational qualification prescribed by UGC/respective Statutory Body, or be an eminent person / accomplished professional from industry.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Walk in interview. Number of positions can be increased or decreased.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Late arrivals will not be permitted to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department level discussion. Recommendation by Committee. Approval by competent authority. Walk-in interview on scheduled date and time.
